## Behaviour

Describe the problem, expected tactical result and final change. Include triggers, start/end transitions, contingencies and Zeus interruption.

## Controls and compatibility

List changed settings/defaults, public APIs, ownership/locality/JIP, dependencies and handover. Link the updated feature documentation.

## Validation

Record static/package checks separately from live audit results. For game results include package fingerprint, batch, locality/dependency variants and remaining failures. Include performance measurements when relevant. State untested behaviour explicitly.
